rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other

The name of the recipient expressed in text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasEvidence

Software provided as a service over a network.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issueTracker

A license expression participating in a license set.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualityAssessmentReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a quality assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hardware

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A container for a grouping of SPDX 3 content characterizing details (provenance, composition, licensing, etc.) about a product.
Specifies the licenseId that is preferred to be used in place of a deprecated License or LicenseAddition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.
This is the state of an affected Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
Provides the location of an external reference.
A point representing the mean position of the matter in a body or system.
Links a vulnerability and one or more elements designating the latter as products not affected by the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: createdBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element's Action or DefinedProcess is createdBy `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 4 - High automation. The system performs parts of its mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: descendantOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a descendant of each `to` Element.
A code that identifies a county.
Commentary on an assertion that an annotator has made.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A mathematical algorithm that maps data of arbitrary size to a bit string.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doesNotAffect
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasPrerequisite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a prerequisite on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Identifies when the Element was originally created.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gln
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Location Number (GLN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gln) is a 13-digit number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a legal entity (e.g., a company or customer), a function within a legal entity, a physical location (e.g., a warehouse or a specific shelf in a store), or a digital location (e.g., an Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) gateway).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.
Defines the beginning of a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a test used to verify functionality on a software element.
Describes the type of annotation.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/ExpandedLicensing/LicenseAddition is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The category describes the hardware item in a DefinedType.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ownership
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Ownership refers to the legal right to control, manage, and benefit from an asset, resource, or responsibility. It establishes authority, accountability, and entitlements over something, whether it's property, a business, intellectual property, or responsibilities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such a social network of friends.
Specified the time and date when a vulnerability was withdrawn.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.
A license or addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.
Timestamp of impact statement.
This is how the currentState of an affected Element is found.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Extension/Extension is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content related to an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: security
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Security profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ismn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Music Number (ISMN)](https://ismn-international.org/ismn/the-ismn/) is a unique numeric identifier for printed music (notated music) standardized by [ISO 10957](https://www.iso.org/standard/83122.html). It consists of either 10 characters (starting with the letter "M" for assignments prior to January 1, 2008) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISMN is composed of four parts: the GS1 prefix `979-0`, a registrant element, an item element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9790006538424`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTestCase
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test case for the `from` Element (`from` hasTestCase `to`).
Specifies the version of a VEX statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.
Specification basis for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdversaryModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the security adversary model for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact is in active development and is not considered ready for formal support from the supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasExample
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an example for the `from` Element (`from` hasExample `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Certificate Revocation List, or CRL, is a list of revoked certificates that is downloaded from the Certificate Authority (CA).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeletedFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a file deleted from the `from` Element (`from` hasDeletedFile `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: complete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: certificationReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a certification report for a package from an accredited/independent body.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an optional component of the `from` Element (`from` hasOptionalComponent `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).
Indicates whether a relationship is known to be complete, incomplete, or if no assertion is made with respect to relationship completeness.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory as defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element uses each `to` Element as a tool, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element optionally depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Service profile specification.
typeFromSource is a value used to define an item within the definitionSource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timeseries
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded in an ordered sequence of timestamped entries, such as the price of a stock over the course of a day.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is metadata about the `from` Element (`from` hasMetadata `to`).
Describes if any sensitive personal information is present in the dataset.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a vulnerability and an element designating the element as a product affected by the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability is not present in the product.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this ListedLicense or ListedLicenseException identifier was first added.
Specifies the value of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Conducting controlled tests, experiments or simulations to verify that specific requirements regarding performance, functionality, robustness, etc. are met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patchedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a patch for the `from` Element (`from` patchedBy `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 9.0 - 10.0.
A value used in a key-value pair with a generic key that refers to an Element

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.
A PlanAction involves the execution of a plan in relation to a PlanProcess.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.
Location is used to define the location, address or coordinates of a place.
A buildType is a hint that is used to indicate the toolchain, platform, or infrastructure that the build was invoked on.
Sets the context for an assessment by specifying the related project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC 9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.
Links a vulnerability and elements representing products (in the VEX sense) where a fix has been applied and are no longer affected.
The destruction process is defined in this process.
Confidentiality level of the data points contained in the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake3
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [BLAKE3](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3-specs/blob/master/blake3.pdf)
Specifies a vulnerability and its associated information.
Process plans outline the stages of implementation or use related to a process.
Specifies the type of an external reference.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasContactPoint
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact has each `to` Agent as a contact point. The use of `hasContactPoint` type is constrained to `ContactPointRelationship` typed relationships. The type of contact (i.e. security) may be specified using a `ContactPointRelationship` element.
Identifies the full text of a License or Addition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The third-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.
Property describing the session in which a build is invoked.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic contact point to be used when the contact type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from` hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vcs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isan
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN)](https://www.isan.org/about/#what_is_isan) is a unique 24-digit hexadecimal identifier for audiovisual works standardized by [ISO 15706](https://www.iso.org/standard/83124.html). The ISAN remains persistent for a work regardless of its distribution format or its use. To facilitate human readability, the "ISAN" label, grouping hyphens, and two check characters are included (e.g., `ISAN 0000-0000-3A8D-0000-Z-0000-0000-6`); however, these elements shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `000000003A8D000000000000`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ancestorOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is an ancestor of each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: phoneNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Phone number; A string of decimal digits that uniquely indicates the network termination point defined in [RFC 3966](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3966/) Section 5.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. To be used with `VulnAssessmentRelationship` types.
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.
Version identifier for the item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: any hashing algorithm that does not exist in this list of entries
Products out of specification require a resolution action. This is the action of resolution.
Anonymization methods used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.
Preprocessing steps that were applied to the raw data to create the given dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the AI profile specification.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.
Property that describes the URI of the build configuration source file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: simpleLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SimpleLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration: Naming Specification Version 2.3](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/nistir/7695/final).
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.
A characterization of some aspect of an Element that is associated with the Element in a generalized fashion.
A key with an associated value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The UUID used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item. UUID, or universally unique ID, is a standard term to refer to verification items.
Requirements can be categorized into various types based on their focus, purpose, and scope.
Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

Provide the enumeration of possible decisions in the [Stakeholder-Specific Vulnerability Categorization (SSVC) decision tree](https://www.cisa.gov/stakeholder-specific-vulnerability-categorization-ssvc).
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: compliance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for compliance (i.e. export control, licensing).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ocsp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Online Certificate Status Protocol, or OCSP, is a common scheme used to maintain the security of a server and other network resources.
Refers to one or more Elements that are part of an ElementCollection.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's build phase, during development.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An authentication protocol not covered by one of the other AuthenticationProtocolTypes.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: device
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a chipset, processor, or electronic board.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerable component is present, and the component contains the vulnerable code. However, vulnerable code is used in such a way that an attacker cannot mount any anticipated attack.
A license that is listed on the SPDX License List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.
Type of the model used in the AI software.
Provides an SSVC assessment for a vulnerability.
Provides the result of an export control assessment.
A prescribed change to a product's location.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasHost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).
CreationAction represents an event of product creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibrn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Registration Number (IBRN)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a unique identifier for legal entities standardized by [ISO 8000-116](https://www.iso.org/standard/75117.html). It is composed of two parts: a jurisdiction prefix and a local authoritative legal entity identifier (ALEI), separated by a colon. The prefix contains an ISO 3166 country code, an optional subdivision code, and a register code (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657`).
These categories help define sets Responsibility Type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isbn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Book Number (ISBN)](https://www.isbn-international.org/content/isbn-users-manual/29) is a unique numeric identifier for monographic publications standardized by [ISO 2108](https://www.iso.org/standard/65483.html). It consists of either 10 digits (for assignments prior to January 1, 2007) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISBN is composed of five parts: a GS1 prefix, a registration group, a registrant, a publication element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9780198836063`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other relevant type of proof or documentation not covered above.
A state is an instance that describes what a system, component, subsystem, process, or project has achieved at any given time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. It consists of two parts: the identifier for the assigning organization (an ISIL) enclosed in square brackets, followed by a local collection identifier string (e.g., `[FR-751041001]Casadesus1`).
EvidenceRelationship defines the association between pieces of evidence and EvaluationResult.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patch
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element contains a set of changes to update, fix, or improve another Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gitoid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Gitoid](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/prov/gitoid), stands for [Git Object ID](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Internals-Git-Objects). A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
